Classical.calibration_requirements: Measure actual separately rendered stem active level and peak; confirm exact original source mapping, musical role, kick audibility and subjective mix; never interpret proposals as universal published dB standards.

musical_definition.scope_note: Project common-practice tonal chamber baseline; not all Western classical music.
musical_definition.groove_behavior: meter hierarchy and phrase rhythm drive motion; no modern groove is imposed unless explicitly hybridized
musical_definition.phrase_behavior: balanced phrase structures with motivic development, cadence hierarchy and sectional contrast
musical_definition.harmony_behavior: common-practice tonal baseline with functional harmony and voice-leading; modal/modern classical requires another profile
musical_definition.bass_behavior: double bass/cello/bassoon or keyboard left hand support harmonic function rather than fixed groove
musical_definition.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: orchestral percussion optional and structurally motivated rather than constant
musical_definition.instrument_role_behavior: strings, winds, brass, keyboard and chamber combinations according to role; orchestration must respect instrument authority
musical_definition.ensemble_player_behavior: ensemble follows score-like dynamic/articulation relationships and shared rubato
musical_definition.arrangement_transformation: motivic development, register transfer, contrapuntal redistribution and formal return
musical_definition.dynamic_behavior: wide phrase-shaped dynamics including crescendos, diminuendos and terraced contrasts where appropriate
musical_definition.articulation_behavior: legato/staccato/tenuto/accent/bow/breath intent passed to instrument authority
musical_definition.timing_humanization_behavior: shared rubato at phrase/cadence level rather than random note displacement
musical_definition.continuous_performance_control: expression, breath/bow/pedal and tempo curves preserved
musical_definition.sound_effects_intent: naturalistic room/depth baseline; effects do not replace orchestration
musical_definition.production_mastering_intent: retain dynamic range; avoid overcompression and excessive brightness
musical_definition.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: target adapters must honor canonical orchestral identities and articulations

Classical.musical_development_policy: Build this genre's melody, harmony, bass, percussion, rhythm, form and expressive behaviors from its own definition and original sample links; no shared melody copying, no source edits, no blended stems.

musical_definition.scope_note: Meter/style family baseline; selecting Waltz alone does not imply Viennese, jazz, country, or classical waltz.
musical_definition.groove_behavior: three-beat meter with beat-one hierarchy; accompaniment pattern depends on selected style rather than automatic oom-pah-pah
musical_definition.phrase_behavior: 4/8-bar phrases with cadence emphasis and possible rubato
musical_definition.harmony_behavior: tonal/modal harmony according to selected style
musical_definition.bass_behavior: beat-one root foundation or melodic bass depending style
musical_definition.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: percussion optional; if used, must reinforce 3/4 without converting to another style
musical_definition.instrument_role_behavior: instrumentation inherited from selected waltz context
musical_definition.articulation_behavior: legato or dance articulation according to substyle
musical_definition.timing_humanization_behavior: rubato allowed at phrase level; three-beat hierarchy stable
musical_definition.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: adapter preserves triple meter and selected instrument identities

PIANIST.calibration_requirements: Measure actual separately rendered stem active level and peak; confirm exact original source mapping, musical role, kick audibility and subjective mix; never interpret proposals as universal published dB standards.

musical_definition.groove_behavior: rhythmic behavior derived from chosen composition; no arranger backing required by default
musical_definition.phrase_behavior: piano-centered phrasing with right/left-hand independence and pedal-aware release
musical_definition.harmony_behavior: tonal/modal/jazz/modern harmony allowed by selected composition profile
musical_definition.bass_behavior: left-hand bass, arpeggio or chordal support; no separate bass required by default
musical_definition.instrument_role_behavior: acoustic/electric piano target as sole or primary voice; optional subtle secondary texture only if profile says so
musical_definition.dynamic_behavior: wide velocity and pedal-shaped dynamic range
musical_definition.articulation_behavior: legato, staccato, accent, arpeggio and pedal behavior
musical_definition.timing_humanization_behavior: human timing follows phrase/rubato and hand coordination
musical_definition.continuous_performance_control: velocity, sustain pedal, soft pedal/expression where supported
musical_definition.sound_effects_intent: room/reverb supports piano body without masking attack
musical_definition.mix_prominence_intent: piano foreground full-range; avoid unnecessary competing layers
musical_definition.production_mastering_intent: preserve dynamic range and natural transients
musical_definition.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires verified piano/electric-piano target voice; if unavailable block rather than substitute guitar
